quantity: intrinsic aqueous head-N micro-pKa (NOT apparent LNP pKa)
runtime_env: conda 'lantern' (py3.10, torch 2.2.2, torch_geometric 2.7); patched torch_scatter->torch_geometric.utils.scatter; OMP guard KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK=TRUE OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
method: predict_base(mol) -> max base-site pKa as head pKa; base-site pKa<3 discarded (symmetric-trialkylamine glitch guard)
validation: MolGpKa MAE ~0.4 vs 15 experimental amine pKa (pyridine 5.13/exp5.23, morpholine 8.9/8.36, aniline 4.77/4.6); xtb ALPB-water physics anchor ~1.6 LOO MAE
cross_project_note: MolGpKa cloned to scratch; not vendored into repo. Cache is the committed artifact.
boundary: intrinsic molecular pKa ~9 differs from apparent LNP pKa ~6.4 (Whitehead & Arral 2026); this is the molecular value used as a transferable head feature.
